concerns.text: Task T028 lists dependencies on T026 and T027, but those tasks are never defined anywhere in the task list, leaving required producers missing.
Task T133 (US2) depends on T028, which is defined later in Phase 5 (US3). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.
User Story 2 tasks (e.g., T016) depend on US1 barrier task T200_us1_ready, meaning US2 cannot be executed independently of US1, violating the independently‑shippable unit rule for user‑story groups.
User Story 3 tasks (e.g., T069) depend on US2 tasks (T018, T021) and US1 tasks, so US3 cannot be shipped independently of earlier stories, breaching the US‑group independence requirement.
Task T017 is marked [P] (parallel‑safe) but writes a model artifact that likely shares the same output path as T018 (also [P]), creating hidden shared state and making parallel execution unsafe.
Task T018 is marked [P] (parallel‑safe) yet may overwrite the same model file produced by T017; without distinct filenames this violates parallel‑safety guarantees.
Task T028 (report generator) depends on undefined tasks T026 and T027, causing missing producer dependencies and preventing deterministic generation of the report.
